maya (pm): Quick sync — we need concrete rollback windows and maintenance contracts for Private (VPC/on-prem). Customers ask: how long is a safe rollback window after an in-place package upgrade?

sam (prod): TL;DR: goal is <30m full rollback for most customers, but we have tradeoffs with DB schema changes and agent restarts. Need tiering. :thinking_face:

alex (eng): Agree on tiers. Proposing:
- Tier A: stateless control-plane-only changes -> 15m rollback target
- Tier B: agent binary + config updates -> 30-60m (depends on nodes)
- Tier C: stateful/DB migrations -> schedule only, rollback not guaranteed

nina (solutions): Customers will want explicit choreography they can run during their maintenance windows. Can we publish a short runbook and a `--dry-run` validation step?

alex (eng): Yes — we'll add `rdu-runbook` CLI and `--validate` step. Example:```
# upgrade sequence (canary first)
redwood-agent upgrade --canary 1 --validate
wait 10m
redwood-agent upgrade --batch 20%
# monitor prefix cache hit, latency -> proceed
```

julia (field): Important: many netops teams require IP ranges + egress ports in an explicit contract. We should pin those for upgrade timeouts and rollback hooks.

rui (sec): Also add a KMS key rotation consideration. If the upgrade touches key config, rollback requires key compatibility. Add "no-key-change" restriction in automatic rollbacks.

maya (pm): Good catches. Let's draft launch criteria for the Private Upgrade feature:
- Published runbook + `--validate` tooling
- Defined rollback SLAs for A/B/C tiers
- Network/egress contract doc with IP ranges and port list
- Field-tested canary with 3 customers and 2 distinct network topologies
- Post-upgrade metrics baseline (latency, cache hit, error rate)

ops-bot: Incident policy update created (#INC-8467) — assigned to @alex (eng) and @julia (field). :white_check_mark:

sam (prod): Prioritization: Q2 sprint 3 for runbook + validate; Q2 sprint 4 for contract docs and canary deployments. Would push full GA to Q3 after customer pilots. Thoughts?

nina (solutions): For pilots, request we include one VPC-peering customer and one air-gapped on-prem customer. They have different failure modes. Add a checklist item for "handshake test" that validates routes + MTU before upgrade.

alex (eng): Adding a small script to run preflight:```
# preflight checks
redwood-agent check-handshake --target gateway.example.com --expect-ports 443,5222
redwood-agent check-mtu --target gateway.example.com
```
If handshake fails, abort and produce a support bundle.

maya (pm): Negotiation note: some customers will insist on longer rollback windows (4-6h). We should offer a paid extended maintenance SLA for that. Add to pricing doc.

rui (sec): One more: require signed manifests for on-prem package installs — rejects unsigned rollback artifacts. This prevents accidental downgrade to unsafe builds.

julia (field): Ops runbook should include a simple rollback command set and a timeline table. Example:```
# rollback example
redwood-agent rollback --to v2024.06.3 --grace-period 20m
# if agents fail to reconnect -> run: redwood-agent recover --mode offline
```
Customer note: instruct them to keep backups of local KV cache before Tier C upgrades.

sam (prod): Acceptance criteria for product readiness: docs + runbook checked into repo, `--validate` succeeds in CI against a mock network, 3 pilot signoffs, SOC review from @rui. Then flip to GA.

maya (pm): Action items: @alex to prototype CLI preflight & validate (owner), @nina to line up 2 pilot customers (owner), @julia to draft field runbook template, @rui to define security constraints, @sam to update roadmap and pricing. Can we target PRs by end of next sprint?

alex (eng): I'll have a prototype branch by EOD Friday. Will post instructions and sample output.

julia (field): I'll start runbook template and share with nina for field testing.

nina (solutions): Looping in @customer-success later for communications.

maya (pm): Cool — closing the sync here. I'll capture this as a scoped initiative: "Private Upgrade: rollback windows, runbook, and network contract" and add to roadmap. :rocket:

ops-bot: Reminder: standup follow-up task created (#TASK-3421) — owners set as above.
